title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis), daily max temperature
summary: Gridded historical weather reanalysis served as a JSON API. For a chosen latitude and longitude it returns daily maximum 2 m temperature (temperature_2m_max, °C) on a requested date range and timezone. The grain is one grid point per query, not a station. The register lists it for UC1 and UC2 with no agreement required. Coverage of the probed dates (2025-07-01 to 2025-07-03 and 2026-03-29 to 2026-03-31) returned values, but the start of the archive was not established.

fields.name: time
fields.description: Daily date, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD), in the requested timezone

fields.name: temperature_2m_max
fields.description: Daily maximum air temperature at 2 m

fields.name: latitude / longitude / elevation / utc_offset_seconds / timezone
fields.description: Returned grid point (snapped to the model grid, e.g. 45.448154, 9.169279 for the query 45.46, 9.19) and the timezone applied

schema.notes: Structure read from the probe responses. The response also carries hourly variables (temperature_2m, shortwave_radiation) when the default hourly parameter is present in the request; only the daily block is needed for N3.

spatial.notes: Coordinates are the only geography key. Query used for probes was 45.46, 9.19 (Milan area) as an illustration only; the shop's location is not named in any source read, so the query point must be chosen and recorded in decisions.md. The register default (38.72, -9.14) is not Italian and must not be used. Snapped grid point returned: 45.448154, 9.169279, elevation 138 m.

licence.name: CC BY 4.0 (API data, as stated by Open-Meteo); upstream Copernicus C3S reanalysis terms also apply to reanalysis content
licence.evidence: probe_url https://open-meteo.com/en/licence (fetched; 'API data are offered under Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)'). The same page lists 'Weather reanalysis, air quality forecasts and elevation data from Copernicus Climate Change Service C3S ( Licence )' and links a Copernicus licence PDF. Source code is AGPLv3. Register terms_url is the same licence page. The page does not name which reanalysis model backs the historical API.
licence.attribution_text: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0 requires a link to the licence and indication of changes)

access.request_process: GET https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive with latitude, longitude, start_date, end_date, daily=temperature_2m_max, timezone=Europe/Rome. Probes returned HTTP 200 JSON. Keep probe ranges small. The register lists approved purposes as prototyping and production, but Legal sign-off is still needed for production use under the open-data policy.

documentation_excerpts: API data are offered under Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) (open-meteo.com/en/licence)
Weather reanalysis, air quality forecasts and elevation data from Copernicus Climate Change Service C3S ( Licence ) (open-meteo.com/en/licence)
quality_notes: Timezone: register default is UTC. Probe with timezone=Europe/Rome returned utc_offset_seconds 3600 and daily dates aligned to local days, so Europe/Rome must be set explicitly.
Reanalysis (model-based), not station observation. Peak heat may be smoothed; no station comparison was done in this profile.
Location: no source read names the shop's city. Coordinates must be chosen and recorded in decisions.md. The register default (38.72, -9.14) is Lisbon-area and not Italian; it must not be used.
Register default_query includes hourly variables; the probes returned hourly data too. Request only daily=temperature_2m_max to limit payload.
Licence page Last-Modified header (10 Nov 2026) is later than the as_of date of the use case (2026-10-15); this is recorded as found and not resolved.
Upstream reanalysis licence (Copernicus C3S) is named on the licence page but its terms were not read; commercial use is therefore unknown.

Daily max temperature for 2025-07-01 to 2025-07-03 returned HTTP 200 with daily temperature_2m_max in °C; timezone Europe/Rome applied (utc_offset_seconds 3600); grid point 45.448154, 9.169279, elevation 138 m
